name: Doppler
label: Doppler API v3
description: Doppler API v3 via OfficialApiNode. Docs: https://docs.doppler.com/reference. Operations: get-secret, list-secrets, update-secrets, delete-secret, list-projects, list-configs, download-config, listen. Auth secret doppler_token is instance config only (never on INPUT, never logged). GET/access operations still call the official GET (or access) HTTP method. Retrieved secret material must not be logged and should stay in StudioQuack secret bindings (bind OUTPUT `data` into a secret; do not print it, persist it in engine variables, or leave it on a logged edge). listen is kind:ingress — use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event. JDK HTTP, official API only.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put doppler_token here. Path params match api_spec.json placeholders. Example: {"operation":"get-secret"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official API call to run. EXACT values: get-secret | list-secrets | update-secrets | delete-secret | list-projects | list-configs | download-config | listen. Prefer the instance config operation select. listen is ingress: no HTTP — use a BPMN message event. Example: 'get-secret'.

schema.label: secrets
schema.description: update-secrets secrets map {NAME: value} or list-secrets names filter.

schema.label: format
schema.description: download-config format: json | env | yaml | docker | env-no-quotes | dotnet-json.

schema.label: change_requests
schema.description: update-secrets change_requests [{name, originalName, value}]. Official alternative to secrets map.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status:ok, http_status, data}. Secret bytes in data must not be logged; bind them into StudioQuack secrets. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON from the official API. May contain secret material — never log; bind into StudioQuack secrets.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official API operation. EXACT: get-secret, list-secrets, update-secrets, delete-secret, list-projects, list-configs, download-config, listen. listen is BPMN ingress, not a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Doppler token
configurationParameters.description: Doppler service token (prefer per-config). Sent as Authorization: Bearer. StudioQuack secret. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Project
configurationParameters.description: Project slug/id. Query/body for secret and config ops. Not required when the service token implies it.

configurationParameters.label: Config
configurationParameters.description: Config name (e.g. dev). Query/body for secret ops. Not required when the service token implies it.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect + read timeout. Default 25. Keep at or below the daemon invoke budget (~300s).

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
